notes: Ocean Beach, the southern stretch of the Great Highway on this sheet (y 3040-3656), made by merging two pieces drawn separately: OB3 (y 3040-3519) and OB4 (y 3520-3656); each polygon running across y 3520 is one polygon over the whole height, its corners at y 3520 dropped where the side is straight through (the two fits agreed there to within a px). OB3's notes: following the settled reading of piece O1 (p05__300_2400_475_640). Lines A-E are straight over the whole box and were fitted over its whole length (ink left-right at y 3040 / y 3519; see below for y 3656): A 600-602 / 628-630, B 615-616 / 643-645, C 623-624 / 651-653, D 636-637 / 664-666, E 659-661 / 689-691 (each within 1 px of its fitted line). Open polygons, each taking its bounding lines: west of A (x 330 to A's east edge: ocean, the wavy shoreline at about x 545-575, beach) = one open polygon; B-C = the median; D-E = the planted strip. Their corners at y 3040 equal O1's (602; 615-624; 635-661). Streets: A-B (the Great Highway; the name GREAT HIGHWAY printed in it at x 615-630, y 3165-3300, is street), C-D (the other roadway), and E-F (the Lower Great Highway, with the heavy zoning border inside it: x 667-673 at y 3040, 697-702 at y 3519). Blocks, one polygon each, corners on the outer edge of each block's thin line: narrow west column 2169 (cut by the top), 2301, and an unnumbered sliver; middle column 2170 (cut by the top), 2302, 2376, 2378; east column, cut by the box's right side (x 792-805): four blocks, the last, 2379, running on into OB4's part (their numbers lie east of the box). Line F (the narrow column's west line) slants faster than 48th Avenue's line (F 676 at y 3040, 685 at 3164, 694 at 3315, 700 at 3411), so the narrow column narrows southward and ends: JUDGMENT CALL (owner to rule): the last piece of the narrow column, x 695-704, y 3335-3411, has a printed top line (y 3335-3337), F as its west side and a straight east line at x 701-704; F meets the east line at about y 3375 and the two run as one line down to y 3411 where both stop, with no bottom line. I typed it as a block (a thin wedge, no number printed), most likely the tail of the narrow column. South of y 3411 there is no F: the Lower Great Highway and 48th Avenue run together as one street from line E to the middle column's west line (x 719-721), with the heavy zoning border inside it; all of it is left street. The heavy zoning borders in 48th Avenue (x 704-714), in the cross streets (y 3323-3329 from x 685 to 714; y 3477-3482 from x 694 to 718), and in 47th Avenue (x 787-792, y 3469-3520) are street; the heavy borders inside blocks 2376 (bump at x 730-790, y 3455-3482), 2378 and 2379 (x 752-805, y 3509-3520) are block. The letters NC-1 below the box are outside it. OB4's notes (y 3520-3656): the drawn ground of this sheet ends at about y 3653-3667; below it the paper is blank down to the frame rule at about y 4020, so the box stops at the blocks' south lines (Ulloa St's north side, y 3654-3656) and every band runs out of its bottom. Lines A-E fitted straight on their ink edges over y 2400-3656 (90% of rows within 0.7 px); ink at y 3656: A 637-638, B 651-653, C 659-661, D 672-674, E 696-699.
